# TinyStudio.io

TinyStudio.io runs a free, human-reviewed leak audit of high-ticket service homepages, and a monthly desk that closes the leaks the audit finds.

Canonical URL: https://tinystudio.io/
Contact: hello@tinystudio.io

## Current Product

TinyStudio reads the one page a high-ticket business's revenue depends on, the way a customer with intent reads it, and names the exact points where they leave. The audit is done by hand, is free, and is the customer's to keep whether or not they ever engage TinyStudio.

The audit runs four passes: the money page, the paid creative, the questions a buyer needs settled before committing, and the reach of new work. Findings are named leaks in priority order, each with the fix beside it, delivered within five working days. Six audits are taken per month; when the sixth is taken, intake closes until the next month.

The Growth Desk closes what the audit finds: month one rewrites or rebuilds the highest-leverage page, with a dev-ready handoff; months two and three run weekly checks, one revision, and tracking that shows whether the fix held. The desk runs at $2,500 per month on a three-month minimum, with a delivery guarantee: if the month-one deliverables are not delivered within fourteen working days of Day 0, month one is refunded in full. Day 0 begins only once payment, access, and both named owners are recorded; the clock pauses when TinyStudio is waiting on the customer.

## The Desk

Seven specialist agents do the research, drafting and checking, each with one job, a fixed input list and a checklist it must satisfy, working from the customer's own pages, reviews, numbers and competitors. A person reviews fit, every claim, all client-facing work, delivery and renewal, and signs every client-facing output.

Automation is never allowed to send anything, publish anything, spend ad budget, or approve, accept or renew its own work.

## Guarantees And Limits

TinyStudio does not promise revenue, rankings, ROAS, conversion, booked calls, or sales volume. The delivery guarantee above is the only promise made about outcomes, and it is a promise about the work, not the market. No campaign publishing. No ad spend changes.

## Evidence Boundaries

TinyStudio does not publish client work: no logos, no case studies, no testimonials, no "as seen at." Market research is the opposite and is shared freely: an automated daily read of the served homepage HTML of businesses that are not clients and have no relationship with TinyStudio. The current count is ninety-nine sites attempted across thirteen industries and eight geographies; eighty-nine readable, ten blocked by bot protection and excluded from every count. Nothing belonging to someone who paid TinyStudio is ever shared.

## Data Handling

The public app stores email signups and lightweight usage metadata in Cloudflare D1, including daily rate-limit counters and a daily IP-derived rate-limit key. There is no public endpoint for reading collected emails or usage metadata.
